what: Plan relies on the existing exit-3 stub test, but that test bypasses the changed producer in scripts/ci-decide.sh
scenario_or_breakage: A typo or wrong token in the new FIX_ATTEMPTS>=10 ci-decide branch would leave the cap on exit 4 while the existing STUB_CI_ACTION=bail STUB_BAIL_REASON=fix-attempts-exhausted test still passes
suggested_fix: Add an end-to-end regression that uses real ci-wait.sh plus real ci-decide.sh, seeds FIX_ATTEMPTS=10 in ship-pr-state, stubs only ci-status.sh to produce a non-merge status, and asserts ship-pr exits 3 with BAIL_REASON=fix-attempts-exhausted and BAIL_NEEDS_USER_INPUT=true

what: The final-bail-reason persistence plan writes the new batch only from refresh-run-logs.sh, but terminal exit-3 paths create final-bail-reason.txt later during Step 18 restore
scenario_or_breakage: When FIX_ATTEMPTS>=10 exits 3, ship-pr.sh exits before postmerge write_finalize_state and no later refresh-run-logs.sh call runs; Step 18 calls write-final-report before restore-finalize-state.sh, then restore creates final-bail-reason.txt just before teardown cleanup, so the planned batch is never committed for the new reachable cap path
suggested_fix: Move restore-finalize-state.sh before Step 17/18 final-report refresh for ship-pr terminal exits or add a terminal pre-teardown larch-log write/flush for final-bail-reason after restore; include an exit-3 cap test that asserts the batch exists in larch-logs before cleanup
